verdicts.strongest_argument: Both guidance ranges are company press-release language and both are published in this capture, verbatim, three months and five months before the print. docs/16f237a987976e363d3ffb5bd1184d3d09021011.txt, message of 2026-03-25T10:21:57Z: 'For the first quarter of 2026 ... aesthetic treatment services revenues to range between RMB268.0 million and RMB278.0 million, representing a 171.2% to 181.3% increase'; and 2026-05-22T10:12:04Z: 'For Q2 2026, So-Young expects aesthetic treatment services revenues to range from RMB307M to RMB317M, representing an 112.6% to 119.5% increase'. The widening loss and the +45.6% consolidated growth are in the same file on the same day. So the two-point series is published, not reachable-only; the side-by-side arithmetic is all that is added. And the arithmetic does not say what the finding says. RMB268-278m guided for Q1 against RMB307-317m guided for Q2 is roughly +14% *sequential* growth in the segment; the year-on-year rate falls only because the prior-year base rises, which the finding itself concedes ('the base effect that produced +170% is gone'). Characterising a segment guided up 14% quarter-on-quarter as 'decelerating hard' is a framing choice, not a discovery. Decisively, the market has already traded exactly this guide: the 2026-05-22 release that contained the RMB307-317m number, the +45.6% revenue and the -$0.48 EPS produced a -16.48% reaction per the baseline's own history block, and the corpus records the pre-market print at -9.4% with the headline 'posts 45.6% Q1 revenue jump as losses deepen'. The unpriced residual is the Q3 guide alone, which no source in or out of this corpus can supply.

verdicts.baseline_evidence: The baseline's history block records -16.48% on 2026-05-22, the date the Q2 guide was published -- the price moved hard on precisely this information. The deeper history is the same reaction function: -22.73% on 2025-08-15, -8.45% on 2025-11-17, 5 of 8 reactions negative, median absolute move 7.12%. The finding cites this itself as corroboration, which is an admission that the market's reaction function to growth-bought-with-losses is already established and observable.
verdicts.what_would_change_it: A corpus datum on the June quarter's actual segment revenue, or any published Q3 guide or consensus for the segment, would separate the unpriced part from the already-traded part; absent that, 75 is the honest split.

verdicts.strongest_argument: The observable content of this finding is the run-up, and the run-up is in the price by definition -- the baseline states it as run_up_20d_pct = 30.43 and quote.json shows the path from 1.99 on 2026-08-04 to 2.40 on 2026-08-28. There is no fact here to be published or unpublished; there is a price series and an inference from it. The inference's central evidence is also a capture artefact rather than a finding about the world: the finding argues from 'the capture's four sweeps returned zero news items', but every SY snapshot records n_queries = 0 (snapshots/20260830T083555Z.json, 20260830T084825Z.json, 20260830T150435Z.json, 20260830T150711Z.json). The capture never ran a news search on this name, so it could not have returned news items whether or not any existed. The 'disclosure vacuum' therefore has no evidentiary basis in this corpus. Nor is the run unexplained inside the corpus: the 2026-08-04 6-K (accepted 21:15:17Z) is followed by 1.99 -> 2.09 on 08-05, +5.0%, which the baseline itself scores as a +5.03% event reaction, and the finding concedes that unread body 'may well contain the reason for the whole advance'. The rest is a low-volume grind on 55k-315k shares with one +8.1% day on 08-19 that coincides with the earnings-date notice posted at 2026-08-19T10:13:27Z. Finally, 'the stock has run up so the print must justify it' is exactly the unsourced run-up argument that cannot be converted into an edge in either direction.

verdicts.baseline_evidence: quote.json: 1.84 (07-31) -> 1.99 (08-04) -> 2.09 (08-05, +5.0% the session after the 6-K) -> a steady grind to 2.40 (08-28), on volumes of 54.8k to 314.2k against a 171,890 twenty-day average. Two identifiable step-ups (08-05 after the 6-K, 08-19 on the earnings-date notice) account for a large share of the move. The advance is orderly and low-volume, which is consistent with re-rating on the 08-04 disclosure rather than with a vacuum.
verdicts.what_would_change_it: Reading the 2026-08-04 6-K body would settle this outright: if it is routine and contains nothing that justifies a 30% re-rating, the finding's residual is real and this falls to 35-45.

interactions: The two findings share the only substantive body in the capture, docs/16f237a987976e363d3ffb5bd1184d3d09021011.txt, and the hunter flags the cluster. They are also in tension: #0 says the print's information content is a guided deceleration that has been publicly available since 2026-05-22, while #1 says no information has arrived at all since 2026-08-04. If #0 is right, the market has had the relevant guidance for three months and #1's 'vacuum' is about news flow rather than information. Both lean on the same +30% run-up as evidence of mispricing -- #0 to argue the deceleration is unpriced, #1 to argue nothing justifies the move -- so counting them separately double-counts one price series.
corpus_limits: This is a very thin capture: four sweeps, all with n_queries = 0, one stored body (a 90-message social feed whose 2026 August content is two earnings-calendar lines), and a filings index. There was no news search at all, so the finding's 'zero news items, zero analyst notes' is an artefact of the capture schedule and is not evidence about coverage in either direction; I have marked SY#1 corpus-silent for that reason. No 6-K body is stored, so the 2026-08-04 filing that plausibly explains the entire advance is unread, and the Q1/Q4 releases reach me only through third-party restatements. event.json reports n_estimates 'N/A' and consensus_eps_forecast null, and the baseline carries no implied move or skew, so nothing here rests on options. No tripwire_tells were set on any SY item; the capture's last bar is 2026-08-28, before the bmo print, so no contamination cut was needed.
